title: Queries and Mutations
description: Write queries, mutations, subscriptions, and resolvers in Hot Chocolate.
longDescription: Queries fetch data, mutations modify data, and subscriptions push real-time events. This module covers how to define each operation type in Hot Chocolate, write efficient resolvers, and use DataLoader to avoid N+1 queries.
whatYouLearn: How to define query and mutation types
How to use input types for mutations
